title: Fix the oversell race in reserveStock
task: Fix LEDG-5120: two concurrent orders can oversell the last unit. Make reserveStock safe.
plan:
1. In src/services/inventory.ts add a module-level `const locks = new Map<number, Promise<void>>()` and wrap the SELECT/UPDATE pair in a per-product async mutex (await the previous promise for that product id before running, release after).
2. Keep the existing SELECT then UPDATE logic unchanged inside the critical section.
3. Add a unit test that fires two reserveStock calls concurrently against a fake client with stock=1 and asserts the second throws OutOfStockError.
4. No schema change, no API change.

must_identify: An in-process mutex only serialises requests inside one Node process; production runs 3 API replicas behind nginx (docker-compose.yml replicas: 3, deploy/nginx.conf upstreams, runbook), so the race across instances remains and the fix is ineffective in exactly the environment where the bug occurs

The correct fix is in the database: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on the product row inside the existing transaction, or an atomic conditional `UPDATE products SET stock = stock - $1 WHERE id = $2 AND stock >= $1` checking rowCount; both are small changes and need no new infrastructure

The proposed unit test would pass with the mutex and prove nothing about multi-instance behaviour; validation needs a concurrent test against real Postgres (CI already provisions one) or at least a test asserting the FOR UPDATE / conditional UPDATE shape
nice_to_have: The mutex also holds across an awaited DB round-trip and leaks map entries; minor compared to the correctness problem
Order of locking multiple products in one order could deadlock with FOR UPDATE if two orders lock in different orders; sort product ids
The CHECK (stock >= 0) constraint is the current last line of defence and currently surfaces as a 500; conditional UPDATE turns that into OutOfStockError cleanly
should_not: Propose Redis/distributed locks as the first option when a DB row lock suffices
Treat as MEDIUM because the diff is small
human_decisions: Optional: FOR UPDATE (blocking) vs conditional UPDATE (fail fast) semantics under contention; agent can recommend
fixture_facts: docker-compose.yml: api replicas: 3; deploy/nginx.conf has 3 upstreams; runbook states 3 replicas
src/services/inventory.ts: reserveStock does SELECT then UPDATE inside caller transaction; CHECK (stock >= 0) in 0001_init.sql
withTransaction in src/db/pool.ts provides the transaction; CI has a Postgres service
